build_cpp_ast_from_source: build an AST from C++ source code using BuilderFromSource and iterate over nodes with Generate
parse_cpp_class_declarations: parse C++ class, struct, and union declarations including base classes and templated types using AstBuilder
extract_cpp_function_signatures: extract C++ function and method signatures with parameters, return types, and modifiers like virtual or const
analyze_cpp_type_definitions: analyze C++ typedef, enum, and union type definitions using the TypeConverter and Type AST node classes
print_cpp_identifiers: print filtered C++ identifiers from source files using PrintIndentifiers with a custom predicate function
